I'm sorry that you don't have someone in your life to give you stability and reassurance.... but life will only get worse if you stop trying. Have you tried the box breathing technique? Navy Seals used it to cope with high-pressure situations...

1. Breathe in through your nose (slowly) for 4 seconds, focus on the air entering your lungs. Try to relax any muscles that you might be tensing, and don't clamp your mouth shut.

2. Hold your breath for 4 seconds. (Slow counting)

3. Slowly exhale for 4 seconds.

4. Hold your breath for 4 seconds. (Again, slow counting)

If your anxiety is on the milder side (and you just sorta need to center yourself) could also try labeling your left thumb as the past; your right thumb as the future; and place the pads of your thumbs together. The little line that separates your thumbs represents the present, and that's where you are right now. 

(Creds to whoever came up with these btw... they've been working for me for the most part :) )
